verses.1: For the redemption of David’s soul.
verses.2: May Jehovah save me! May He be my help.
verses.3: They will search and dig, those who seek souls. They will be destroyed, and those who desire evil will be defeated.
verses.4: Let them return to their tracks, those words that were spoken by the one who said “Oh!”
verses.5: May they be blessed and rejoice in you. May they always say, “May God bless you, my friends who bring salvation to me.”
verses.6: I am poor and needy; may God help me. Please, do not leave me alone. You, LORD, do not abandon me.
